segments.he: וְלֹא אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה – עַד שֶׁיְּהֵא בָּהּ תִּשְׁעָה קַבִּין לָזֶה, וְתִשְׁעָה קַבִּין לָזֶה כּוּ׳. וְלָא פְּלִיגִי; מָר כִּי אַתְרֵיהּ, וּמָר כִּי אַתְרֵיהּ.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «And» the court does «not» divide a jointly owned «field unless there is» space «in it» to plant «nine kav» of seed «for this one and nine kav» of seed «for that one.» Rabbi Yehuda says: The court does not divide a field unless there is space in it to plant nine half-kav of seed for this one and nine half-kav of seed for that one. The Gemara comments: «And» they «do not disagree» with regard to the fundamental halakha, as this «Sage» ruled «in accordance with» the custom of «his locale, and» that «Sage» ruled «in accordance with» the custom of «his locale.» In Rabbi Yehuda’s locale, even a smaller parcel of land was considered a viable field.
